title: Repair, Not Improvement: Decomposing Constrained Decoding in Tool-Call Abstention
abstract: arXiv:2608.13959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Function calling is what the recent accounting of constrained generation explicitly sets aside: it finds the decoder's contribution small for format constraints, then warns in its Section 7 against extrapolating where a constraint encodes a correctness requirement, and names function calling as one. Tool abstention is that case at its sharpest: an enum leaves the wording of an answer alone and narrows the set of answers there are, and declining to call anything is the first it drops. We measure the excluded case. Three conditions over one byte-identical prompt separate a grammar's two jobs: it fixes where generation stops as well as which tokens may be emitted. We evaluate open-weight models from 0.6B to 4B on matched English and Korean items, so the language comparison is made within item. translated_title: 修复而非改进：分解工具调用放弃中的约束解码
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13959v1 公告类型：新 摘要：函数调用是近期关于约束生成的研究明确排除的内容：该研究发现解码器对格式约束的贡献很小，并在其第7节中警告不要将约束编码正确性要求的情况进行外推，且将函数调用列为其中之一。工具放弃正是这种情况最尖锐的表现：枚举类型不改变答案的措辞，而是缩小了答案的集合，而拒绝调用任何工具是首先被丢弃的选项。我们测量了这一被排除的情况。在字节相同的提示下，三种条件区分了语法的两个职责：它既确定生成停止的位置，也确定可以发出的令牌。我们评估了从0.6B到4B的开源权重模型，在匹配的英语和韩语条目上，因此语言比较是在条目内进行的。与无约束解码器相比，先前工作的对比在六个单元格中的四个上对放弃任务呈负相关，且置信区间不包括零，最差为-29.5个百分点。
tldr: 本论文针对工具调用放弃场景，分解了约束解码中语法的双重作用，并实证发现先前的约束解码方法在该场景下显著劣于无约束基线，表明需要专门修复而非改进。
en_tdlr: This paper decomposes the dual roles of grammar in constrained decoding for tool-call abstention, empirically showing prior methods underperform unconstrained baselines in this setting, indicating a need for repair rather than improvement.
